verdict.rationale: The README shows `llama cli -hf <repo>` and `llama serve -hf <repo>`, which fetch and run a model directly from Hugging Face on the command line. That covers the download part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows searching for models or managing local ones (listing, removing, updating), and the download flag appears only as bare example commands. missing for 10: CLI model search, local model management (list/delete/update), detailed docs on -hf download behavior and caching, independent or hands-on corroboration
